create_pipeline_regional_prompting: create a RegionalPromptingStableDiffusionPipeline instance with vae, text_encoder, tokenizer, unet, scheduler, safety_checker, and feature_extractor
run_regional_prompting_cols: run the pipeline with rp_args mode cols and div ratio to divide image into vertical columns for regional prompting
run_regional_prompting_rows: run the pipeline with rp_args mode rows and div ratio to divide image into horizontal rows for regional prompting
run_regional_prompting_prompt_mode: run the pipeline with rp_args mode prompt and th thresholds to generate images using attention-based regional masking
run_regional_prompting_base_prompt: run the pipeline with KBASE keyword in prompt and base_ratio to blend base prompt with regional prompts
